writtenBefore: any tracking output of the frozen reference outside gap1150 was produced
frozenReference: hlg-bc709-g2.2-v1, bench/hdr_reference.py at commit 22a58b9 (moduleSha256 in freeze.json)

comparison.default: unchanged default decoder: cv2.VideoCapture (OpenCV 4.14.0.94 wheel, Linux container)
comparison.heldConstant: source commit, models (4 SHA-256), cpu-onnx profile env (ONNX CPU, batch 1, keyframe 1, discovery 416, OCR enhance 0, 2 threads, PYTHONHASHSEED 0), thresholds, evaluation definitions; fresh output and cache directories per decoder

footageInventory.IMG_4809_proxy_10fps.mp4: HLG BT.2020 H.264 High 10 x264 proxy of IMG_4809.MOV; the only HLG footage with identity labels
footageInventory.IMG_4809.MOV: original iPhone 15 Pro HEVC Main 10, HLG, Dolby Vision profile 8 configuration record; same match as the proxy (NOT independent); no labels on its own time base; technical checks only
footageInventory.IMG_4529 / IMG_5105: other matches, SDR BT.709 8-bit H.264; claim-audit labels only (boxes the 5.0/5.1 engine claimed); the reference refuses SDR, so these serve only as SDR-compatibility controls of the default path

selection.rule: all labelled 30 s intervals of gt_img4809_intervals.json (no selection by outcome)
developmentSample: 1150-1180 (gap1150: the window every earlier 5.3 analysis used; baseline-reproduction anchor)
selection.status: these 8 are existing developer evaluation labels from the same match, used in 5.1/5.2 evaluation and gates: they are held out from the 5.3 decode analysis only, NOT independent footage and NOT a holdout in the strict sense
selection.independentVideos: none with HLG and identity labels

scenarioDescriptors: computed per interval from labels and default-decoder stage-1 output (target box heights, label counts, cuts, camera-motion magnitude, frame luma) - not from candidate outcomes
timeBasis: verified per interval with pp_bench.best_label_time_shift on default-decoder detections against N labels; the IMG_4809 correction record is applied only where that check confirms it; both bases reported
metrics: per interval and aggregate: correct, wrong-player, overlap-ambiguous, unmatched, "?"-label claims, abstained, confirmed vs likely, automatic only (no owner anchors), counts with denominators; intervals without target labels report claims only (safety)

expansionCriteria.E1: any wrong-player or overlap-ambiguous claim, or more unmatched / "?"-label claims for the candidate than the default in any interval -> trace each such claim to its earliest pipeline difference before any further conclusion
expansionCriteria.E2: a full-match comparison (both decoders, ~2-4 h each locally) is the next stage only if E1 finds no unexplained safety regression; it is not run in this task
expansionCriteria.E3: an independent labelled HLG match is required before any promotion proposal

nonGoals: no decoder default change, no threshold change, the reference is not tuned on these outcomes
